reason: I'd probably grab the 14-day trial since nothing gets charged, but on my budget I'm not adding another subscription when the free version already plays without ads and turns off on a timer. I already fall asleep fine-ish with my own earphones and YouTube ASMR.
objection: Fading the sound out at the right moment is nice, but is it worth 4,900 won a month to me? I cut subscriptions like this every month, and I doubt the 14-day comparison will show a big enough difference for me to keep paying.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fall asleep 10+ minutes faster and the yearly plan were closer to 20,000 won, I'd pay once for the year.
